page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7ne.large is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with 2 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon 8369HB processor running at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The instance is configured with 2 physical cores and 1 thread per core. It includes 8.0 GB of system memory, providing a 4.0 GB memory-to-core ratio. There is no local storage bundled with this instance, and it does not feature any GPU accelerators. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

In benchmark evaluations, the instance demonstrates moderate single-core performance alongside lower multi-core and memory throughput. The stress-ng single-core CPU test yielded 1572.49, placing it in the average tier, while the multi-core CPU performance scored 2070.9, which falls into the lower percentile. Single-threaded compression tasks performed steadily, with gzip compression reaching 27.19 GB/sec and bzip3 decompression achieving 10.47 GB/sec. However, memory bandwidth is limited, with large-block read and write speeds measured at 16.29 GB/sec and 14.38 GB/sec respectively. Database and web serving benchmarks also reflect lower-tier throughput, with static web serving at 2.48 GB/sec and Redis SET operations at 2.02 million operations per second.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio, the ecs.g7ne.large offers a predictable entry-level environment for workloads that do not require high parallel processing or massive memory bandwidth. The hardware profile is qualitatively cost-efficient for basic general-purpose tasks, lightweight application hosting, and development environments. It is best suited for single-threaded applications, small-scale web serving, and lightweight background utility tasks where dedicated CPU resources are preferred over shared-core burstable instances.
